chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Muawiya ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

When you buy an animal, say: 'O Allah, if it is great in blessings, abundant in benefit, and of auspicious forelock, then facilitate its purchase for me; and if it is otherwise, then turn me away from it to that which is better for me. Indeed, You know and I do not know, and You are able and I am not able, and You are the Knower of the unseen.' Say this three times.

key_terms.دَابَّة: Animal (specifically a beast of burden or livestock)

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended prayer when buying an animal in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi outlines a practical supplication for purchasing livestock, emphasizing the concept of *istikhara* (seeking the best) by invoking Allah's attribute as 'All-Knowing of the Unseen.' It reflects the Shia scholarly tradition of combining commercial transactions with spiritual mindfulness, ensuring that material acquisition aligns with divine wisdom rather than mere human preference.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Ammar,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Whenever you buy an animal (a vehicle), so say, ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! If there will be great Blessings, Grace, profits, of auspicious forelocks, so Ease its buying for me; and if there are to be other than that, so Turn me away from it to that one which is better for me than it, for You<sup>azwj</sup> Know and I do not know, and You<sup>azwj</sup> are Able and I am not able, and You<sup>azwj</sup> are the Knower of the unseen’ – You should be saying that three times’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar, who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

When you decide to buy an animal, say this, “O Allah, if this is of great blessings, extra benefits and of a fortunate nature, I pray to You to make its purchasing easy for me. If it is otherwise, then turn me to what is better than this; You know and I do not know. You have power over all things but I do not have such power and You know the unseen.” You should say this three times’”
